title: LampAttention: Look-Ahead Mixed-Precision FlashAttention for Dedicated Accelerators
abstract: arXiv:2609.39361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While most attention logits can be computed in low precision without degrading numerical stability, current attention kernels fail to exploit this phenomenon. We introduce a novel hardware-algorithm co-design in the form of mixed-precision FlashAttention. Our method accumulates key-query products and evaluates their exponentials in 8-bit formats, then adaptively identifies sensitive sub-blocks and recomputes them in 16-bit formats. We propose the specifications for a dedicated accelerator capable of executing this pipeline efficiently. Simulated experiments with Qwen3 and Gemma 3 show that rerouting a selective minority of sub-blocks to high precision is sufficient to recover the baseline model performance.

translated_title: LampAttention：面向专用加速器的前瞻混合精度FlashAttention
translated_abstract: 虽然大多数注意力logits可以在低精度下计算而不损害数值稳定性，但当前的注意力内核未能利用这一现象。我们提出了一种新颖的硬件-算法协同设计，即混合精度FlashAttention。我们的方法以8位格式累加键-查询乘积并计算其指数值，然后自适应地识别敏感子块并用16位格式重新计算。我们进一步提出了能够高效执行该流水线的专用加速器规格。基于Qwen3和Gemma 3的仿真实验表明，仅将少数被选择性地识别出的子块重新路由到高精度计算，就足以恢复基线模型的性能。
tldr: 提出LampAttention混合精度FlashAttention软硬件协同设计，以8位精度计算大多数注意力子块、自适应识别敏感子块并用16位重算，配合专用加速器规格，在不损失模型性能的前提下大幅提升注意力计算效率。
en_tdlr: LampAttention introduces a mixed-precision FlashAttention hardware-algorithm co-design that computes most attention sub-blocks in 8-bit precision while adaptively recomputing sensitive ones in 16-bit, paired with a dedicated accelerator specification to boost attention efficiency without degrading model performance.
